toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog_add
toolsAdded.description: Adds one task to the orc backlog through orc backlog add, and returns what orc prints, which names the new task's id. When a planner model is set and the request is over budget, orc adds it as a parent with one child per slice instead, prints one line per task, and the beat starts the independent children together. The task has no priority, so no beat starts it or its children until the captain sets one with orc backlog priority. When the task closes, orc chat posts its outcome and its PR, or its report for a scout or task, and later posts when its PR turns green and when it merges.

project.description: The project the task is for, as the backlog's project list names it

task.description: The task as markdown, whose first line is its title

kind.description: ship ends in a PR and is the default; scout and task end in a report file in the run folder instead; parent holds the done criteria and waits for its children

internal.description: Marks a ship task internal-only, so a no-mistakes-prod-only project opens its PR after checks without no-mistakes

machine.description: The one machine the task may run on

parent.description: The id of the parent task this task is a child of

dependsOn.description: The ids of the tasks that must close done before this one starts

priority.description: The order the beat starts new tasks in: 0 starts first and 4 starts after the other priorities. Set one whenever the captain asks for work to happen, using the rank the captain's words give, or 2 when they rank nothing

toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog
toolsAdded.description: Returns orc backlog --json: every new, taken and closed task with its project, kind, machine, outcome, PR and report, the project list, and the room on each machine.

toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog_hold
toolsAdded.description: Holds one new task through orc backlog hold, so no beat starts it until the captain answers. A passed until date does not release it; only orc_backlog_answer does. Holding a held task again keeps the first reason. A hold with questions waits for an answer to each one, and orc_decision_board puts them on cards for the captain.

id.description: The id of the new task that waits for the captain

reason.description: The decision the captain must make before the task may start

until.description: The YYYY-MM-DD date the captain should answer by; it releases nothing by itself

questions.description: The separate questions the captain answers one by one, ids question-1 onward; the task stays held until every one is answered

toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog_priority
toolsAdded.description: Sets or clears the priority of one new task through orc backlog priority, which orders the beat's starts: 0 starts first, 4 starts after the other priorities, and none clears it. orc refuses a task that is taken, started or closed.

id.description: The id of the new task whose priority changes

priority.description: 0 to 4 for the rank the beat starts the task at, or none to clear it

toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog_edit
toolsAdded.description: Replaces the title and the body of one new task through orc backlog edit, and keeps its id, kind, machine, parent, dependencies, hold and parked questions. It works on a held, parked or parent task, and orc refuses a task that is taken, started or closed, since a run has already read its text. It never splits the task.

id.description: The id of the new task whose text changes

task.description: The task's whole new text as markdown, whose first line is its title

toolsAdded.name: orc_backlog_answer
toolsAdded.description: Records the captain's words through orc backlog answer, word for word. On a held task it releases the task for the next beat, or on a hold with questions answers the one named and releases the task once every question is answered. On a parked task it answers the one question named, and the beat resumes the run on its branch once every question is answered.

id.description: The id of the held or parked task

question.description: The id of the parked or held question the captain answers, such as question-4; leave it out for a task held with a reason and no questions

words.description: The captain's answer, word for word

toolsAdded.name: merge_task
toolsAdded.description: Squash-merges a closed task's PR through orc merge, which merges nothing and says why when the PR is not open, a check is red or has not reported, or the branch is behind its base. Call it only when asked to merge that PR, with basis captain-word on the captain's explicit word, or with basis yolo-green when asked about a yolo project's PR and the PR is green. orc refuses yolo-green for a project without yolo true.

id.description: The id of the closed task whose PR lands

basis.description: captain-word when the captain explicitly said to merge this PR. yolo-green when asked to merge a yolo project's PR and the PR is green

toolsAdded.name: orc_decision_board
toolsAdded.description: Builds a Lavish decision board for one held or parked task, with one card per open question on its hold or park, each with options and the option you recommend, and returns its link for the captain; it opens no browser. Anyone on the same network who holds the link can open it and submit answers, which orc records as the captain's through orc backlog answer, word for word, because the page has no login. orc posts what it recorded here, and releases the task only once every card is answered. The board is never published through lavish-axi share, a third-party host, or a public tunnel.

id.description: The id of the held or parked task the board decides

question.description: The id of the held or parked question this card answers, such as question-2; leave it out when the task was held with a reason and no questions

options.description: The options the captain picks one of, each recorded word for word when picked

recommended.description: The option you recommend, written exactly as it appears in options

question.description: The id of the held or parked question this card answers, such as question-2; leave it out when the task was held with a reason and no questions

options.description: The options the captain picks one of, each recorded word for word when picked

recommended.description: The option you recommend, written exactly as it appears in options

cards.description: One card per open question on the hold or park
